title: A selection range keeps to its own field
notes: `knows *1..2` from `a` follows `knows` only, not the other fields that share its kind, as a filter's walk does (zega#86).

knownFailure.reason: zegadb/zega#86 review H1: the pinned engine (2b5ebd2) follows every relationship of a field's kind in a `*min..max` walk, so `knows` also reaches b through `fan` and `scout`; this case records its outcome until the pin moves.
